edge_crossings.source: architecture derivation on zstack.json radial corners and layers, main_height_map.json F.Cu courtyards/heights and the display_land planning ranges below; recomputed by arch_diagrams.py check
edge_crossings.model: Every conductor that joins a REAR/BATTERY-level item to a MAIN F.Cu connector rises in the annulus beside the pack and bends 90 deg over the MAIN edge into the front gap (or the reverse for the sensor FPC). Z: the conductor runs above F.Cu with its lower face at height h and must stay under the display support land, so h <= h_max = front_gap - t_land - c - t. Bend: with inner radius R_bend the board corner (R_main, F.Cu) must lie inside the bend hollow, (R_main - R_start)^2 + (R_bend - h)^2 <= R_bend^2, so the bend may start s(h) = sqrt(R_bend^2 - (R_bend - h)^2) inboard of the MAIN edge (s = R_bend for h >= R_bend, s = 0 for a flat exit). Vertical run inner face R_v = max(R_main + R_bend - s(h), R_channel_inner); margin = R_case_inner - (R_v + t + c). The display outline (R 21.95) does not constrain a downward bend; the earlier assumption that the bend starts at R >= 21.95 is withdrawn. The margin is bounded below by a flat exit (h = 0, identical to the tool 180-degree edge-wrap margin when R_bend >= t_main/2) and above by an exit at the land ceiling (h = h_max). The actual exit height and mouth radius are connector/harness data (SR-FPC-MECH, SR-CHG-MECH, SR-BATT-PCM).
edge_crossings.corner_mapping: nominal: every term nominal. conservative: tool conservative radial corner, front_gap of the tool thin corner (smallest gap) with c_front at min (same corner), t_land and w_land at max, t_lower_web at min. optimistic: the mirror image (tool optimistic radial corner, thick front_gap with c_front max, t_land and w_land at min, t_lower_web at max). Conductor terms t / c / R_bend are the tool t_fpc / c_fpc / R_bend_min of the same radial corner for every crossing (flat-flex stand-in where the conductor is not an FPC).

display_land.concept: Case support / bond land behind the display rim: an annular ledge at the top of the front gap (directly behind the display rear plane) from R_display - w_land out to the case wall. atm5.plate_check_method: Linear small-deflection Kirchhoff plate, circular, uniform pressure p (Roark / Timoshenko closed forms): D = E t^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)); clamped edge: w = p a^4 / (64 D), sigma = 3 p a^2 / (4 t^2); simply supported edge: w = (5 + nu) p a^4 / (64 (1 + nu) D), sigma = 3 (3 + nu) p a^2 / (8 t^2). A PSA / adhesive ring on a ledge lets the edge rotate, so simply supported is the sizing case; clamped is the optimistic bound. Flagged beyond small-deflection validity when w / t > 0.5 (membrane stiffening then makes the linear result conservative).

electrical_evidence.assessment: 0402 MLCC in 4.7 uF and 2.2 uF exist as a class (no MPN invented). At 3.0 V a 6.3 V-class 0402 4.7 uF part loses a large share of its capacitance to DC bias; the effective capacitance must be checked against eMMC VCC guidance and, if short, C901 split into two 0402 parts (same height) or C902/C901 re-balanced. assembly.S0: Battery isolated at accessible external development break/fixture; charger detached. Probe bare MAIN F.Cu and TP1301-TP1306. Mate no live battery connector.
assembly.S1: Bond/test REAR tail on its inner face before carrier insertion. Fit carrier, pack insulation and independent charger module. For B.Cu options hold MAIN B.Cu-up on a jig, mate cold, rotate about the single common tangent hinge in joint_book_fold with computed joint slack (isolated option hinges are lower bounds only) in the OUTSIDE assembly jig, then capture slack in its reserved pocket. F.Cu connectors mate visibly before the display. Connect battery last for bring-up; isolate again before any manipulation.
assembly.S2: Remove SWD probe/clip; verify carrier guide-pin relief. Connect J1 visibly with display hinged; close display onto support land without trapping the fold. Blind Z-mating is allowed only after SR-J1-ALIGN fixture verification. Caseback remains open; connectors beneath the display cannot be accessed directly.
assembly.S3: Inspect strain relief, separated charger feedthrough and seals; close caseback using hard stops. No external SWD requirement. Rework reverses S3 to S1 with battery isolation BEFORE moving MAIN/display; log every J1 cycle. A bonded REAR tail is serviced by replacing the REAR+tail unit through J1501, not repeated tail peeling.
assembly.isolation: Use an external development battery disconnect in the test fixture before closing the stack; for a sealed unit detach charger and open caseback, isolate pack at a supplier-provided accessible pack-tail break before lifting MAIN.
